versions.name: Geometrize2GD
versions.description: Simple parser from Geometrize format to GD

about:
# Geometrize2GD

This is an unofficial fork, which continues maintanence over the original mod.

This a mod that imports objects from [Geometrize Web Demo](https://www.samcodes.co.uk/project/geometrize-haxe-web/) or [Geometrize Desktop App](https://www.geometrize.co.uk/) format to GD.

### [Usage Guide](https://github.com/lawr0ne/Geometrize2GD/wiki/Usage-Guide)

## Credits
- **sh1ne_dev** (Original Developer of the mod.)
